(HR)

**Ukoliko nemate važeću EU COVID potvrdu, ne možete pristupiti prostorima natjecanja zbog pravila stožera civilne zaštite Republike Hrvatske o javnim okupljanjima. MORATE posjedovati EU COVID potvrdu kako biste se mogli natjecati na ovom natjecanju. Provjerite COVID dio na stranici za više informacija..**

Osijek Open 2022 je natjecanje koje se već tradicionalno održava krajem zime u Osijeku. Bilo tko može sudjelovati, bez obzira na nacionalnost i starost, no svatko mora biti upoznat s WCA Pravilnikom te posjedovati važeću EU COVID potvrdu.

Natjecanje je pod organizacijom Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska. Kotizacija pokriva trošak organizacije i najma prostora. Mogući višak kotizacije ide u svrhu razvitka Udruge Speedcubing Hrvatska.

Za više informacija, proučite ostale kartice na stranici natjecanja.

--------------

(EN)

**If you don't posses EU COVID Pass, you are not permitted to enter the venue due to Croatia's COVID-19 measures for public gatherings. You MUST posses EU COVID Pass to compete at this competition. Check COVID tab for more information.**

Osijek Open 2022 is a competition that is traditionally held near the end of winter in Osijek. Anyone can participate, no matter which nationality or age they are, but they need to be familiar with the WCA Regulations and have valid EU COVID pass.

This competition is being organized by the Speedcubing Association Croatia. Registration fee covers the cost of the organization and venue rental. Any extra money goes directly to support Speedcubing Association Croatia.

For more information, check other tabs on the competition website.

items.name: Cubing Returns Ghaziabad 2022
items.information:
## NOTE: Competitor limit of 30 has been reached. Participants can still register on the waiting list and pay. In case of any cancellations, paid registrations from the waiting list will be accepted on a first-come-first-served basis. Participants on the waiting list are eligible for a refund till 4th March 2022 11:59 PM GMT+5:30.

* Make sure you are present at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. Latecomers will not be accommodated under any circumstances.
* If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or are not aware of competition rules, make sure you attend the **Tutorial for New Competitors**.
* If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please carry an ID proof.

All participants are expected to volunteer for the event when they are not participating. The roles could be of a judge, runner, or a scrambler, depending upon the situation.

# COVID-19 Guidelines

* One of the following proofs is mandatory for all participants and guests:
	1. Proof of negative RTPCR within 72 hours from the competition date (i.e sample collected on/after 16th March)
	2. Proof of full vaccination (both doses) with second dose at least 14 days prior to the competition date (i.e second dose on/before 5th March)
* Participants and guests under the age of 5 are exempted from providing the above mentioned proof.
* Participants and guests failing to submit the proof will not be allowed to enter the venue. **NO REFUND** will be given in that case.
* Maximum **ONE** guest is allowed to accompany a participant inside the venue. We strongly encourage participants to not bring any guests as a COVID-19 preventive measure.
* Wearing masks, sanitizing hands frequently and following all local goverment protocols is mandatory inside the venue.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/PLUNxN2022#17389-competitor-responsibilities) tab.
